title: Capture Intelligence: FY2027 Federal Health Budget

signals.signal: $56.2B community care (+17%); VBP models and utilization management enter new contract
signals.what_to_do: If you are bidding: final compliance review against Section L this week. If you are a subcontractor on a CCN team: confirm your teaming agreement covers VBP scope. If you are not on a team: this window is closed for new entrants.
Small set-aside opportunity. Dental network primes with VA past performance should be in pre-proposal review now.

signals.program: EHRM / Oracle Health (MHS GENESIS at VA)
signals.signal: $4.24B appropriation request; 13 MTF go-lives scheduled Q3-Q4 FY2026, 26 additional sites FY2027
signals.what_to_do: If you hold a position on the GENESIS support contract: scope expansion brief to DHA program office this quarter. If you are a subcontractor: identify which go-live sites align with your past performance; initiate teaming conversations with the prime now, not at draft RFP. If you are a new entrant: this is not the window — focus on FY2028 recompete positioning instead.

signals.signal: TBD program scope; remote patient monitoring and clinical decision support platform
signals.what_to_do: Position for RFI response. Build past performance narrative around RPM and CDS integration.

signals.signal: TEFCA enforcement and information blocking penalties expanding to all covered entities
signals.what_to_do: If you provide HIE services: update capability statements to reference TEFCA compliance. If you are an EHR vendor: ensure FHIR endpoints meet December requirements.

signals.signal: DIPS contract consolidation into enterprise imaging platform; estimated $380M over 10 years
signals.what_to_do: Incumbent (Philips) vulnerable on interop requirements. MOSA compliance will be weighted. Clinical AI imaging partners should initiate teaming conversations now.

signals.signal: New program office; $120M initial allocation for clinical AI validation frameworks
signals.what_to_do: Academic and research-oriented firms should monitor for BAA. This is not a traditional IDIQ opportunity — expect cooperative agreements.

signals.signal: Multi-billion dollar claims processing modernization; legacy COBOL systems replacement
signals.action_window: Proposals in evaluation; award expected Q4 FY2026
signals.what_to_do: If you submitted: no action. If you did not: position for subcontracting once prime is announced.

signals.signal: $1.8B sustainment contract for deployed MHS GENESIS sites
signals.action_window: Recompete FY2028; pre-positioning window opens Q1 FY2027
signals.what_to_do: Current subs should lock teaming agreements before recompete announcement. New entrants: build relationships with the deployed site PMOs now.

signals.signal: GSA MAS Refresh 31 makes Transactional Data Reporting mandatory across all schedules
signals.what_to_do: All GSA MAS holders must update reporting systems. Non-compliance risks schedule cancellation.

signals.signal: DHA requiring CMMC Level 2 for all health IT contracts starting FY2027
signals.what_to_do: Begin C3PAO engagement now if you do not have CMMC Level 2. Lead time for assessments is 6-9 months.

signals.signal: $310M in directed research funding for combat casualty care and operational medicine
signals.what_to_do: Research institutions should monitor CDMRP funding opportunities portal. This is grant/cooperative agreement, not contract.

signals.signal: Indian Health Service EHR modernization; moving from RPMS to commercial EHR
signals.action_window: Market research phase; RFI expected FY2027
signals.what_to_do: EHR vendors with tribal health experience should respond to upcoming RFI. Past performance in rural and underserved settings will be critical.

signals.signal: Continued investment in public health data infrastructure; $250M FY2027 request
signals.action_window: Multiple task orders expected Q1-Q2 FY2027
signals.what_to_do: Firms with public health surveillance and data integration experience should monitor CDC ORISE and direct contract opportunities.

signals.signal: OptumServe won $1.61B single-award IDIQ (April 10, 2026); first TO is $11M transition-in; 4 task orders expected over 10-year POP; population expanded to DHS civilians
signals.action_window: TO 2-4 over next 18 months — subcontracting window for behavioral health, dental, audiology, vision, lab
signals.what_to_do: If you were a sub on RHRP-3 (LHI/OptumServe team), confirm teaming-agreement portability to RHRP-4 now. If you are new, approach OptumServe's federal arm directly — single-award IDIQ means zero prime opportunity but all 4 task orders will require specialty subs. Population expansion to DHS civilians (CBP/TSA/FEMA readiness) is the scope-creep watch.
